NEOW.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.0-1.char: I did not come back to take anything.
NEOW.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.0-3.char: What remained no longer belongs only to me. I can only admit that it crossed a boundary from my side.
NEOW.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.1-0.ancie: [sine]...they... saw... what you did not hide...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.1-1.char: They chose to cross that line. I choose to admit that it was not held firmly enough.
NEOW.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.1-2.ancie: [sine]...admitting... cannot... make the trees... grow back...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.1-3.char: No. Nor can what you did be reduced to a shadow I left behind.
DARV.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.0-0.ancie: Now that record is hard to put a price on! Nobody's holding it, but it's still changing things.
DARV.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.0-1.char: Then it belongs in no one's collection.
DARV.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.0-2.ancie: Then at least keep track: who touched it, and who put it back.
DARV.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.0-3.char: I will. Not to reclaim it.
DARV.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.1-0r.anci: Not taking it? Then don't blame me for whatever story it becomes later!
DARV.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.2-0r.anci: First to find a thing ain't always the one it belongs to. I know that much!
OROBAS.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.0-0.anc: This changes! That changes! Why don't you change them back?
OROBAS.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.0-1.cha: Because they are no longer what they were.
OROBAS.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.0-2.anc: You won't change back the bad things either?
OROBAS.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.0-3.cha: To erase the bad would erase the traces of how they survived as well.
OROBAS.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.1-0r.an: Keep changing! I want to see what it becomes at the end!
OROBAS.talk.DIMENSIONAL_TRAVELER.2-0r.an: Observe, observe! Don't stand in front of change!
